profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at IQGeo
profile.summary: Experienced Web Application Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in full stack software development. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Computer Science from Brigham Young University.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Geospatial productivity & collaboration
IQGeo’s geospatial software accelerates productivity and collaboration across enterprise sales, planning, design, construction, and maintenance processes for telecoms and utility network operators.

positions.title: Web Development Instructor
positions.description:
Aided in creating curriculum for JavaScript (ES6), Angular, React, NPM and others
Taught software engineering core concepts and patterns using JavaScript
Helped students understand and adopt software development best practices

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Design, develop, and test new features on existing applications.
Help architect new applications and systems.
Introduce best practices and coding standards for new technologies like Angular and Typescript.
Help build and formalize a continuous delivery software cycle.

positions.title: Web Applications Developer
positions.description:
Developed new product features using SQL(Oracle), Java(Spring), and Typescript(Angular) 
Brought about the intercommunication of two separate applications via rest services
Spearheaded migration of AngularJS application to the new Angular framework

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed and tested new features for existing products
Implemented testing of current features in Java and C++
Worked with different levels of abstraction from GUIs to hardware

positions.title: Chair/President
positions.description:
Led 8 other officers in in efforts to help BYU CS students become better programmers, do service and to expand their professional network. At BYU ACM We participate in programming competitions (ICPC, Microsoft Coding Challenge, etc.), run our own competitions (with 8 other schools from around the state of Utah), organize recruitment events, serve the community with weekend of code projects, and helpe develop programming skills. 

Visit acm.byu.edu to learn more

positions.title: Research Assistant - Human Centered Machine Learning
positions.description:
Explored swarm organisms’ decentralized decision making
Computer modeled honey bee’s swarm selection patterns and decisions
Collaborated on modeling approach decisions and implementations

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
Managed team of 5 representatives
Taught self development skills such as personal accountability and self-motivation
Brought $500,000 of revenue to company in an twelve month period

projects.title: iOS App Developing
projects.description: Designing and developing useful apps in iOS

projects.title: Web Developing
projects.description: I like learning web developing skill by designing and implementing websites on my spare time.
